description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans management grain functionalities, focusing on verifying grain activation address retrieval and handling special cases such as stateless worker grains. It includes test classes, test interfaces, and their implementations.

classes.name: ManagementGrainTests
classes.description: Unit test suite for Orleans Management Grain operations, including activation address querying and handling of stateless worker grains.

classes.name: IDumbWorker
classes.description: Interface for a stateless worker grain used in tests to verify management grain behavior with stateless grains.

classes.name: DumbWorker
classes.description: Implementation of a stateless worker grain class with a no-op method, used in activation address tests.

classes.name: IDumbGrain
classes.description: Interface for a stateful grain used to test management operation on regular grains.

classes.name: DumbGrain
classes.description: Implementation of a stateful grain class with a no-op method.

methods.name: GetActivationAddressTest
methods.description: Test method that verifies the correctness of activation address retrieval for normal, unactivated, and stateless worker grains, including exception handling.
